camel_example: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnWafFilterInfo --region cn-hangzhou --DefenseScenes custom_acl --Language cn
description_en: Call DescribeDcdnWafFilterInfo to query the match fields, logical operators, and match content available for custom mitigation policies
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnWafFilterInfo查询自定义防护规则中匹配条件的匹配字段、逻辑符和匹配内容等信息
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-waf-filter-info --defense-scenes custom_acl --biz-language cn --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnWafFilterInfo

parameters.help_en:
The types of mitigation settings. Separate multiple types with commas (,). The following scenarios are supported:

waf_group: basic web protection

custom_acl: custom mitigation policies

whitelist: whitelist

If you do not specify this parameter, information for all types is returned
parameters.help_zh:
防护策略类型列表，多个用逗号（,）分隔。目前支持以下场景：
waf_group：Web基础防护

custom_acl：自定义防护策略

whitelist：白名单

不传时，代表返回全部信息
parameters.name: defense_scenes

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

en (default): English

cn: Simplified Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
设置返回信息语言。取值范围：

en（默认）：英文

cn：简体中文
parameters.name: language

DefenseScene.description_en: The type of the mitigation setting. This is the same as the DefenseScene request parameter
DefenseScene.description_zh: 防护策略类型，同请求参数的DefenseScene

ExtendField.description_en: An extended tip for the match field. If this parameter is empty or not returned, no extended field is available
ExtendField.description_zh: 匹配字段的扩展tip，无此字段或此字段为空表示无扩展字段

Attributes.description_en:
The configurable properties. This is a bit field variable. For more information, see the following table.
Example: 1 (binary 00000001) indicates that you can enable case sensitivity but not stream matching. 3 (binary 00000011) indicates that you can enable both case sensitivity and stream matching.

Bit (from low to high) - Description 1 - Case sensitivity 2 - Stream matching
Attributes.description_zh:
可设置的属性，位域变量，具体内容见下表
例：1(0000 0001)表示可开启大小写敏感，不可开启流式匹配；3(0000 0011)表示可开启大小写敏感，也可开启流式匹配 位（低位到高位）- 描述 1 - 大小写敏感 2 - 流式匹配

Description.description_en: The logical operator displayed in the console
Description.example: Equal to one of multiple values.

MaxLength.description_en:
The maximum number of match content entries that you can specify. The value of this parameter varies based on the value of Type:

If Type is set to multi, this parameter indicates the maximum number of entries.

If Type is set to single, the value of this parameter is 1.

If Type is set to none, the value of this parameter is 0
MaxLength.description_zh:
匹配内容可输入的最大个数限制，根据Type取值不同，该参数取值如下：

取值为multi时，表示可输入的最大个数限制。

取值为single时，该参数为1。

取值为none时，该参数为0

ErrMsg.description_en: The error message returned if the content does not match the regular expression
ErrMsg.description_zh: 匹配不上正则表达式的错误信息

Symbol.description_en: The logical operator that is passed to the backend
Symbol.description_zh: 代码内部传给后端逻辑符

Tip.description_en: The tip that is displayed for the match content
Tip.description_zh: 匹配内容中显示的提示信息
Tip.example: You can enter multiple values, up to 50. Press Enter to confirm.

Type.description_en:
The number of match content entries that you can specify. Valid values:

multi: You can specify multiple match content entries.

single: You can specify only one match content entry.

none: You cannot specify any match content
Type.description_zh:
可输入的匹配内容个数，取值：

multi：可输入多个匹配内容。

single：仅可输入单个匹配内容。

none：不能输入
